claims.text: The hotel is in Tsim Sha Tsui and offers suites with harbour views.

findings.quote: Luxury suites with harbour views await in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui, where calm meets elegance at Regent Hong Kong.

claims.text: The hotel is at 18 Salisbury Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong.

findings.quote: 18 Salisbury Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong

claims.text: Rooms and suites are designed by Chi Wing Lo.

findings.quote: Designed by Chi Wing Lo, each room and suite embodies serene sophistication

claims.text: Rooms have a windowfront daybed facing the harbour views.

findings.quote: Awe-inspiring Framed Views of Victoria Harbour take centre stage in your Personal Haven. Enjoy the majestic view while relaxing on the windowfront daybed.

claims.text: Bath rituals use Perricone MD products.

findings.quote: Curated bath rituals with luxurious Perricone MD products enhance tranquillity.

claims.text: Harbourview and Seaview Suites include access to Regent Club.

findings.quote: Reserve a Harbourview or Seaview Suite to enjoy bespoke service on your terms at Regent Club

claims.text: Suite stays include laundry of three items per stay, a locally inspired welcome snack, selected beverages and local beer.

findings.quote: With our compliments, enjoy laundry of three items per stay, a locally inspired welcome snack, selected beverages and local beer

claims.text: Regent Club offers breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails, plus in-room check-in.

findings.quote: - Breakfast served in Regent Club
- Afternoon Tea
- Evening cocktails
- The privacy and convenience of in-room check-in

claims.text: The Steak House grills prime meat on its original charcoal grill and has a salad bar.

findings.quote: Relish curated selections of prime meat from pristine farms around the world, perfectly seared on our original charcoal grill.
an elaborate salad bar

claims.text: Nobu Hong Kong serves the Japanese cuisine of chef Nobu Matsuhisa.

findings.quote: Nobu Hong Kong makes a magnificent return showcasing the unique Japanese cuisine of world-famous chef Nobu Matsuhisa.

claims.text: Harbourside serves breakfast, lunch and dinner buffets of Asian and Western cuisine at the edge of Victoria Harbour.

findings.quote: Harbourside’s immersive buffet experience transports you to the world’s local markets, focusing on Asian and Western cuisine.
Dining at the edge of Victoria Harbour, gaze at the bustling activity and connect with its vitality over decadent breakfast, lunch and dinner buffets.

claims.text: The Lobby Lounge has panoramic views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong Island skyline and serves afternoon tea.

findings.quote: Be captivated in an oasis with awe-inspiring panoramic views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong Island skyline. Delight in this legendary place over afternoon tea

claims.text: In the Oasis Bathroom, a sliding door reveals a framed view of the harbour from the bath, and a moongate leads to the bath and shower.

findings.quote: A sliding door reveals a Framed View of the harbour from the immersive bath. A moongate serves as an enticing threshold leading to a unique bath and shower experience.

claims.text: The duplex Presidential Suite has a private rooftop terrace and infinity swimming pool with views of Victoria Harbour.

findings.quote: the stunning duplex Presidential Suite with a private rooftop terrace and infinity swimming pool, all with majestic views of Victoria Harbour.

claims.text: Regent Club, designed by Chi Wing Lo, is raised like a ship's bridge over The Lobby Lounge on the harbour side.

findings.quote: Elevated like the bridge of a cruise ship overlooking The Lobby Lounge on the harbour side and the hotel entrance on the city side, this exclusive light-filled retreat designed by Chi Wing Lo

claims.text: Qura Bar has a lounge, a bar and a cigar room with Art Deco and vintage accents.

findings.quote: an eclectic sensory journey through a cosy lounge, a stunning bar and an intimate cigar haven. Blending the glamour of a bygone era with Art Deco and vintage accents

claims.text: The entrance has a cascading fountain leading to a passageway of golden LiuLi-inspired glass.

findings.quote: a cascading fountain leads to an enticing passageway of shimmering golden LiuLi inspired glass

claims.text: Children under 12 are not permitted at Qura Bar.

findings.quote: Children under 12 years old are not permitted.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the five-star positioning.
